ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge,conda-forge/label/python_rc
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
mysql_devel:
- '9.7'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.15.* *_cp315
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
- - python
  - channel_sources
name: mysqlclient
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: mysqlclient
  version: "2.3.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: bea8294964266f6486f1ca514ccfcdbc54d4fe0d32882b38c1d4594df870be8b

build:
  number: 1
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - python -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-cache-dir -vvv
      # rattler-build >=0.59 no longer falls back to build.bat for an empty script
      else: build.bat

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - pkg-config
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    # provides mysql-libs via a run_export
    - mysql-devel
    - if: win
      then: mariadb-connector-c ==3.4.3
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - MySQLdb
        - MySQLdb.constants
        - MySQLdb.cursors

about:
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python interface to MySQL
  homepage: https://github.com/PyMySQL/mysqlclient-python
  documentation: https://mysqlclient.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - InterferencePattern
    - halldc
    - synapticarbors
